article_blocks.text: Strain Type: 60% Indica / 40% Sativa
Genetics: Lemon Cherry Cookies Auto × Sundae Thumper
Breeder: Fast Buds
THC Content: 28%
CBD Content: Less than 1%
Terpene Profile: N/A
Primary Flavors: Cherry candy, citrus, creamy cookies
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8 weeks from seed to harvest
Outdoor Harvest Time: 8 weeks from seed
Indoor Yield: 450–550 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: 60–180 g per plant
Grow Difficulty: Easy to moderate

Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto is built around excess in a very compact package. The buds can shift between purple, pink, and green while developing a glossy coat of resin, and the aroma arrives just as loudly: sweet cherry, fresh citrus, creamy cookie dough, ripe mango, and a faint floral funk all compete for attention. Fast Buds created the strain by crossing its award-winning Lemon Cherry Cookies Auto with Mephisto Genetics’ Sundae Thumper F4, joining two autoflower lines already recognized for premium flower quality. The result is an F1 feminized auto capable of reaching approximately 28% THC while completing its entire cycle in roughly eight weeks.

That combination of speed and strength is only part of the appeal. Plants naturally branch into wide, productive bushes rather than concentrating everything into one narrow central cola, and flowering sites can stack so heavily that branch support becomes useful near maturity. Height generally remains around 70–110 cm, allowing the cultivar to fit into small indoor gardens while still delivering breeder-listed yields of 450–550 g/m². Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto is therefore less about making compromises for convenience and more about translating modern dessert cannabis into a genuinely fast autoflowering format.
Genetics and Lineage

Fast Buds bred Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto from Lemon Cherry Cookies Auto × Sundae Thumper F4. Lemon Cherry Cookies Auto provides the colorful cherry-citrus side of the pedigree and is itself a three-way autoflowering polyhybrid created from Purple Lemonade Auto F6 × Cookies Auto F5, followed by a cross to a dark-purple Cherry Cola Auto phenotype. That ancestry layers lemon, purple-fruit character, Cookies sweetness, resin, and deep pigmentation into a parent already selected for substantial potency and strong visual appeal.

Sundae Thumper brings a different kind of dessert influence. Mephisto Genetics developed it from Gelato #45 × Forum Stomper, with Gelato #45 tracing to Sunset Sherbet × Thin Mint Cookies . Forum Stomper contributes additional Cookies-family resin and grape-oriented sweetness, while Gelato #45 supplies creamy dessert notes, lemon, gas, dense flower structure, and a smooth hybrid effect. Mephisto worked the line through multiple generations, selecting heavily for the unmistakable Gelato #45 aroma and hard, compact flower morphology before producing the F4 material used in this cross.

The resulting F1 combines two highly worked autoflower parents rather than simply adding ruderalis flowering behavior to a photoperiod strain. Lemon Cherry Cookies contributes color, cherry, citrus, and candy, while Sundae Thumper reinforces cream, Cookies, vigor, flower stacking, and resin production. Fast Buds classifies the finished cultivar at roughly 60% indica and 40% sativa, a balance that appears both in its broad, productive growth pattern and in effects that begin brighter before becoming progressively more physically relaxing.
Effects and Experience

The initial phase tends to feel upbeat and mentally active. Mood can rise quickly, ordinary activities become more engaging, and conversation, music, gaming, or creative work may feel easier to settle into. Despite the indica majority, the cultivar does not usually begin with an immediate heavy body stone. Instead, the brighter side of Lemon Cherry Cookies and the headier opening inherited from Sundae Thumper create a noticeably euphoric first stage.

Physical calm develops underneath that mental energy rather than replacing it all at once. Shoulders loosen, movement becomes less urgent, and the faster cerebral edge gradually softens into a comfortable hybrid state. Moderate servings can remain social and functional for experienced consumers, while larger amounts bring the indica side much further forward. The later portion may become deeply relaxing, appetite stimulating, and increasingly suitable for an evening without demanding responsibilities.

Potency is a serious consideration. Fast Buds lists THC at up to approximately 28%, placing Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto among very strong autoflowering cannabis . Consumers with limited tolerance may find even a modest serving more intense than expected, particularly because the sweet flavor can make repeated inhalation easy. Excessive intake may cause dry mouth, dry eyes, dizziness, racing thoughts, or temporary anxiety before the heavier physical effects develop.
Medical Benefits

The movement from mental uplift into body relaxation may appeal to medical cannabis consumers seeking a hybrid experience rather than one dominated by either stimulation or sedation. Earlier effects may make everyday stress, low mood, or mental fatigue feel less intrusive, while the gradual physical component can reduce awareness of muscular tightness or general discomfort. Smaller servings may preserve more mental engagement, making dosage an important part of how the strain fits into an individual’s routine.

Stronger consumption shifts the experience in a noticeably calmer direction. Physical heaviness can increase, appetite may become more pronounced, and the later stage may encourage rest. These characteristics can make the cultivar more suitable to late-afternoon or evening use for many people. Its high THC potential also means that sensitive consumers should proceed cautiously, since a dose intended to relax may instead cause temporary anxiety or excessive intoxication.

CBD remains below 1%, so the cannabinoid profile is strongly THC dominant. Fast Buds does not publish a universal laboratory terpene panel for every plant, meaning the chemistry of one harvest should not automatically be assigned to another. Consumers using marijuana therapeutically should rely on batch-specific cannabinoid and terpene testing when available and account for personal tolerance, medications, and previous cannabis experience.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Cherry and citrus form the brightest part of the bouquet. The cherry can resemble candy or ripe red fruit rather than a medicinal cough-syrup note, while citrus provides enough acidity to sharpen the sweetness. These aromas become especially expressive once the flowers are broken apart, when the resin releases a much fuller combination of fruit and dessert characteristics.

Creamy Cookies influence follows underneath. Sundae Thumper contributes a smooth Gelato-like sweetness, while mango gives the profile a softer tropical component that broadens the fruit beyond lemon and cherry. A subtle floral funk prevents the aroma from becoming completely confectionary, giving mature buds a more recognizably cannabis-driven depth once the initial sweetness settles.

The flavor generally begins with cherry candy and citrus before moving toward cream, Cookies, and ripe mango. Vaporization can preserve the brighter fruit and floral elements particularly well, whereas combustion tends to emphasize the creamy resinous background. A careful dry and slow cure are important because the cultivar’s most appealing qualities come from keeping multiple lighter aromatic layers intact rather than allowing the profile to collapse into generalized sweetness.
Growing Information

Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto begins vigorously and naturally develops multiple side branches, giving it a wide, bushy shape with many potential flowering sites. Fast Buds lists mature height at approximately 70–110 cm, making this weed variety compact enough for tents, balconies, greenhouses, and other restricted spaces. Light low-stress training early in development can open the canopy further, but aggressive high-stress techniques are less useful with such a short life cycle because an autoflower has limited time to recover before reproductive growth takes over.

The complete cycle can finish in approximately eight weeks under favorable conditions, with indoor production around 450–550 g/m². Buds stack rapidly once flowering accelerates and can become heavy enough that stakes or a trellis are useful. The breeder describes the strain as forgiving and not especially fussy about feeding, which makes it more approachable than its premium appearance suggests. Even so, stable irrigation and avoiding overfeeding are important because excessive stress during the early weeks cannot be compensated for with a longer vegetative period.

Outdoor plants can produce approximately 60–180 grams each and do not depend on shortening autumn days to initiate flowering. Growers can therefore schedule harvests by planting date, and multiple cycles may be possible during a long warm season. Dense oily flowers should still be protected from prolonged rain and stagnant humidity. Phenotype variation can produce different balances of purple, pink, and green coloration, but the productive branching, heavy resin, and cherry-citrus dessert profile remain central features throughout the line.
FAQ
What strains make Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto?

Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto was bred by Fast Buds from Lemon Cherry Cookies Auto × Sundae Thumper F4. Lemon Cherry Cookies Auto combines Purple Lemonade Auto, Cookies Auto, and Cherry Cola Auto genetics, while Sundae Thumper comes from Gelato #45 × Forum Stomper.
Is Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto indica or sativa?

Fast Buds classifies the cultivar at approximately 60% indica and 40% sativa. Its effects reflect that balance, beginning with brighter euphoria and mental engagement before becoming progressively more relaxing and body centered.
How much THC does Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto have?
The breeder lists THC at up to approximately 28%, with CBD below 1%. Actual cannabinoid levels depend on phenotype, lighting, plant health, harvest maturity, curing, and laboratory testing.
How long does Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto take from seed to harvest?
Fast Buds lists a cycle of approximately eight weeks under favorable conditions. Because it is an autoflower, flowering begins automatically and no 12/12 light-cycle change is required.
How much does Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto yield?

Indoor production is approximately 450–550 g/m², while outdoor plants are listed around 60–180 grams each. Actual harvest weight depends on light, root volume, environment, plant health, and how smoothly the short autoflowering cycle progresses.
Final Thoughts on Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto

Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto represents the modern direction of autoflower breeding particularly well. Fast Buds paired its award-winning Lemon Cherry Cookies Auto with Mephisto Genetics’ highly worked Sundae Thumper F4, creating an F1 hybrid where autoflowering speed is already established on both sides of the pedigree. The result can reach approximately 28% THC without requiring the long cultivation schedule once associated with elite high-potency cannabis.

The garden traits are equally compelling. Compact 70–110 cm plants naturally create productive side branches, complete the cycle in roughly eight weeks, and can yield around 450–550 g/m² indoors. Outdoors, planting date rather than seasonal photoperiod determines harvest, making the cultivar useful for growers who want rapid turnover or more than one crop during favorable weather. Heavy bud stacking may require support, but the overall growth pattern remains forgiving.

Its strongest identity ultimately comes from the combination of appearance and flavor. Purple, pink, and green flowers sit beneath dense resin, while cherry candy, citrus, mango, creamy Cookies, and floral funk create a layered dessert profile. Paired with effects that begin euphoric before settling into deeper relaxation, Lemon Cherry Sundae Auto shows how far autoflowering marijuana has moved beyond simple convenience: it offers speed, serious potency, premium resin, modern flavor, and substantial production in the same compact plant.
